en: Adiabene as an ancient kingdom in northern Mesopotamia, corresponding to the heartland of ancient Assyria
Its varying size, initially between the Zab rivers and eventually including Nineveh and beyond
zh: 阿迪亚波纳是美索不达米亚北部的古代王国，地域相当于古亚述的核心区
疆域大小随时间变化，最初在两条扎布河之间，后扩展至尼尼微等地

politics.zh: 阿迪亚波纳是美索不达米亚北部的古代王国，地域相当于古亚述的核心区，疆域大小随时间变化，最初位于两条扎布河之间，后扩展至尼尼微及周边。它在帕提亚与罗马之间周旋，王室一度皈依犹太教，1至2世纪成为罗马与帕提亚争夺的缓冲地带，3世纪后并入萨珊波斯的行政体系。
politics.en: Adiabene was an ancient kingdom in northern Mesopotamia, corresponding to the heartland of ancient Assyria. Its size varied over time: initially it lay between the Zab rivers and it eventually gained control of Nineveh and further territory. Manoeuvring between Parthia and Rome, its royal house at one point converted to Judaism, and in the first and second centuries it served as a buffer contested by the two empires before being absorbed into Sassanid administration in the third.

economy.zh: 王国位于底格里斯河上游的农业区，谷物、果品与手工业是经济基础，处在连接美索不达米亚、亚美尼亚与波斯的商路上，过境贸易与税收是王室收入来源。
economy.en: The kingdom lay in the farming districts of the upper Tigris, where grain, fruit and crafts formed the economic base, and it stood on the routes linking Mesopotamia, Armenia and Persia, with transit trade and taxation supplying royal income.

culture.zh: 阿迪亚波纳是亚述与犹太、希腊文化交汇的地区，王室皈依犹太教的记载见于约瑟夫斯，本地阿拉米语与叙利亚语传统延续，考古发现显示其城市与宫殿建筑。
culture.en: Adiabene was a meeting place of Assyrian, Jewish and Greek culture, the conversion of its royal house to Judaism is recorded by Josephus, local Aramaic and Syriac traditions continued, and excavations reveal its cities and palaces.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元前1世纪成为独立王国、1世纪王室的皈依与对外扩张、2世纪与罗马的战争，以及3世纪后并入萨珊波斯的行省体系。
events.en: Key moments are its emergence as an independent kingdom in the first century BC, the conversion of its royal house and its expansion in the first century AD, the wars with Rome in the second and its absorption into the Sassanid provincial system after the third.

value.zh: 位于美索不达米亚北部，相当于古亚述核心区。
value.en: It lay in northern Mesopotamia, the heartland of ancient Assyria.

value.zh: 王室一度皈依犹太教，见于约瑟夫斯记载。
value.en: Its royal house at one point converted to Judaism, as Josephus records.

en: The Principality of Mingrelia, also known as Odishi and Samegrelo, as a historical state in Georgia
Its rule by the Dadiani dynasty
zh: 明格列尔公国又称奥迪希或萨梅格列罗，是格鲁吉亚的历史国家
由达迪亚尼王朝统治

politics.zh: 明格列尔公国又称奥迪希或萨梅格列罗，是格鲁吉亚西部黑海沿岸的历史国家，由达迪亚尼王朝统治。它在格鲁吉亚王国解体后成为地方公国之一，与伊梅列希、古利亚和阿布哈兹等政权并存，长期在奥斯曼帝国与俄国之间周旋，19世纪中叶被俄国废除公国地位，纳入帝国行政体系。
politics.en: The Principality of Mingrelia, also known as Odishi and Samegrelo, was a historical state in Georgia on the western Black Sea coast, ruled by the Dadiani dynasty. After the Georgian kingdom dissolved it became one of the local principalities, existing alongside Imereti, Guria and Abkhazia, and it manoeuvred for a long time between the Ottoman Empire and Russia until Russia abolished it in the mid-nineteenth century and absorbed it into its administration.

economy.zh: 经济以黑海沿岸的农业、园艺与港口贸易为基础，波季与祖格迪迪是重要城镇，玉米、葡萄酒与柑橘是主要物产，市场与输入商品依赖黑海航路。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, horticulture and port trade along the Black Sea, with Poti and Zugdidi as important towns, maize, wine and citrus as the main products, and its markets and imported goods depending on Black Sea shipping.

culture.zh: 明格列尔语与格鲁吉亚语并用，东正教修道院与贵族宫廷是文化中心，地方民歌与舞蹈传统延续至今，达迪亚尼家族的宫殿与收藏留下遗产。
culture.en: Mingrelian and Georgian were both spoken, Orthodox monasteries and the noble court were centres of culture, local song and dance traditions survive, and the palaces and collections of the Dadiani family remain as heritage. Its monasteries were endowed by the princely house.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15至16世纪公国的形成、与奥斯曼帝国的长期关系、18世纪的内部纷争，以及19世纪中叶被俄国废除。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the principality in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, its long relationship with the Ottoman Empire, internal conflicts in the eighteenth century and its abolition by Russia in the mid-nineteenth.

value.en: It was ruled by the Dadiani dynasty.
Russia abolished it in the mid-nineteenth century.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该公国的独立条目（该实体没有中文 sitelink），叙述依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on this principality, the entity having no zhwiki sitelink, so the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.

en: Judea as a mountainous region of the Levant traditionally dominated by the city of Jerusalem
Its present division between Israel and the West Bank
The derivation of the name from the Hebrew for Judah
zh: 犹地亚是黎凡特的山地地区，传统上以耶路撒冷城为中心
今分属以色列与约旦河西岸
名称源自希伯来语的犹大

politics.zh: 犹地亚是黎凡特的山地地区，传统上以耶路撒冷城为中心，名称源自希伯来语的犹大，今分属以色列与约旦河西岸。历史上这里先后属于以色列王国、犹大王国、波斯、希腊化诸国与罗马，公元6年成为罗马的犹地亚行省，66至73年的犹太战争后耶路撒冷被毁，地区此后由罗马、拜占庭与伊斯兰政权相继统治。
politics.en: Judea is a mountainous region of the Levant traditionally dominated by the city of Jerusalem, its name derived from the Hebrew for Judah, and it is now divided between Israel and the West Bank. Historically it belonged in turn to the kingdom of Israel, the kingdom of Judah, Persia, the Hellenistic states and Rome; it became the Roman province of Judaea in AD 6, and after the Jewish war of 66-73 Jerusalem was destroyed and the region passed under Roman, Byzantine and Islamic rule in succession.

economy.zh: 山地农业以橄榄、葡萄与谷物为主，耶路撒冷与希伯伦是宗教与商业中心，朝圣与手工业带来收入，罗马时期的道路与税制把当地经济纳入帝国体系。
economy.en: Farming in the hills centred on olives, vines and grain, Jerusalem and Hebron were centres of religion and commerce, pilgrimage and crafts brought income, and Roman roads and taxation tied the local economy into the imperial system.

culture.zh: 犹地亚是犹太教的核心地区，第二圣殿与拉比传统在此形成，希腊化与罗马文化的影响同时存在，基督教与后来的伊斯兰传统也在此留下重要遗迹。
culture.en: Judea is the core region of Judaism, where the Second Temple stood and the rabbinic tradition took shape, Hellenistic and Roman influence was present at the same time, and Christianity and later Islam also left important monuments there.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元前6世纪巴比伦之囚后的回归、公元前2世纪马加比起义、公元6年成为罗马行省，以及66至73年犹太战争与135年巴尔·科赫巴起义。
events.en: Key moments are the return after the Babylonian exile in the sixth century BC, the Maccabean revolt of the second century BC, the creation of the Roman province in AD 6, the Jewish war of 66-73 and the Bar Kokhba revolt of 135.

value.zh: 名称源自希伯来语的犹大。
value.en: The name derives from the Hebrew for Judah.

value.zh: 公元6年成为罗马的犹地亚行省。
value.en: It became the Roman province of Judaea in AD 6.

en: Israel, officially the State of Israel, as a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia
Its borders with Lebanon, Syria, Jordan and Egypt, and its Mediterranean and Red Sea coasts
zh: 以色列正式称以色列国，位于西亚南黎凡特地区
北邻黎巴嫩，东北接叙利亚，东界约旦，西南连埃及，西临地中海，南端达红海

politics.zh: 以色列国是西亚南黎凡特地区的国家，北邻黎巴嫩，东北接叙利亚，东界约旦，西南与埃及相邻，西临地中海，南端抵达红海。1948年根据联合国分治决议建国，此后经历多次中东战争，与部分阿拉伯国家逐步实现关系正常化，耶路撒冷地位与巴勒斯坦问题仍是地区政治的核心议题。
politics.en: The State of Israel is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia, bordered by Lebanon to the north, Syria to the north-east, Jordan to the east and Egypt to the south-west, with its western coast on the Mediterranean and its southern tip reaching the Red Sea. Founded in 1948 under the United Nations partition plan, it has fought several Middle Eastern wars, has gradually normalised relations with some Arab states, and the status of Jerusalem and the Palestinian question remain central to regional politics.

economy.zh: 经济以高科技、制造业、农业与服务业为基础，钻石加工、医药、软件与网络安全产业在国际市场占有位置，滴灌等农业技术在干旱地区被广泛采用。
economy.en: The economy rests on high technology, manufacturing, agriculture and services, with diamond processing, pharmaceuticals, software and cybersecurity holding places in international markets, and agricultural techniques such as drip irrigation widely used in arid regions. Exports are concentrated in technology and chemicals.

culture.zh: 以色列社会由来自欧洲、中东、北非与埃塞俄比亚等地的犹太移民及其后代构成，希伯来语为官方语言，阿拉伯语具有特殊地位，宗教与世俗传统并存，文学、音乐与科技文化活跃。
culture.en: Israeli society is made up of Jewish immigrants and their descendants from Europe, the Middle East, North Africa and Ethiopia, Hebrew is the official language with Arabic holding a special status, religious and secular traditions coexist, and its literature, music and technological culture are lively.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1948年建国与第一次中东战争、1967年六日战争、1973年十月战争、1979年与埃及和约，以及1990年代以来的和平进程与关系正常化。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of the state and the first Middle East war in 1948, the Six-Day War of 1967, the October War of 1973, the peace treaty with Egypt in 1979 and the peace process and normalisation of relations since the 1990s.

value.zh: 1948年根据联合国分治决议建国。
value.en: It was founded in 1948 under the UN partition plan.

value.zh: 西临地中海，南端抵达红海。
value.en: Its coasts lie on the Mediterranean and, at its southern tip, the Red Sea.

en: Jordan, officially the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, as a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia
Its borders with Syria, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Israel and Palestine, and its access to the Red Sea at Aqaba
The Jordan River flowing into the Dead Sea
zh: 约旦正式称约旦哈希姆王国，位于西亚南黎凡特地区
北邻叙利亚，东接伊拉克，东南与南接沙特阿拉伯，西界以色列与巴勒斯坦，西南在亚喀巴湾通红海
约旦河流入死海

politics.zh: 约旦哈希姆王国位于西亚南黎凡特地区，北邻叙利亚，东接伊拉克，东南和南部与沙特阿拉伯接壤，西部与以色列和巴勒斯坦相邻，西南在亚喀巴湾通向红海，约旦河流入死海。国家由哈希姆家族统治，1946年脱离英国托管独立，1950年合并约旦河西岸，1988年放弃对该地区的主权要求，1994年与以色列签订和约。
politics.en: The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan lies in the Southern Levant region of West Asia, bordered by Syria to the north, Iraq to the east, Saudi Arabia to the south-east and south, and Israel and Palestine to the west, with access to the Red Sea at Aqaba and the Jordan River flowing into the Dead Sea. Ruled by the Hashemite family, it became independent from the British mandate in 1946, annexed the West Bank in 1950, renounced its claims there in 1988 and signed a peace treaty with Israel in 1994.

economy.zh: 经济以服务业、旅游业、磷酸盐与钾盐开采及侨汇为基础，亚喀巴港是唯一出海口，水资源短缺是长期制约，与海湾国家的劳务输出联系紧密。
economy.en: The economy rests on services, tourism, phosphate and potash mining and remittances, the port of Aqaba is its only outlet to the sea, water scarcity is a lasting constraint, and labour migration to the Gulf states is closely linked to its economy.

culture.zh: 约旦社会以阿拉伯部落传统与伊斯兰文化为基础，另有基督教社群，佩特拉与杰拉什等古代遗址是世界闻名的文化遗产，阿拉伯语为官方语言。
culture.en: Jordanian society rests on Arab tribal tradition and Islamic culture, with Christian communities as well, and ancient sites such as Petra and Jerash are world-famous cultural heritage, with Arabic as the official language. Its handicrafts and cuisine are known across the region.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1921年建立外约旦酋长国、1946年独立、1948与1967年两次中东战争、1988年放弃西岸主权要求，以及1994年与以色列和约。
events.en: Key moments are the creation of the Emirate of Transjordan in 1921, independence in 1946, the Middle East wars of 1948 and 1967, the renunciation of claims to the West Bank in 1988 and the peace treaty with Israel in 1994.

value.en: It became independent from the British mandate in 1946.

value.zh: 亚喀巴港是唯一出海口。
value.en: The port of Aqaba is its only outlet to the sea.

en: The Khanate of Kokand as an early modern state in the Fergana Valley of Central Asia
Its extent at its peak from the Ulu Tau mountains in the north to Sariqol in the south and from Aq Masjid in the west to Karakol in the east
zh: 浩罕汗国是中亚费尔干纳盆地的早期现代国家
极盛时北起乌卢套山，南至萨里科尔，西自阿克马斯基德，东至卡拉科尔

politics.zh: 浩罕汗国是中亚费尔干纳盆地的早期现代国家，极盛时北起乌卢套山，南至萨里科尔，西自阿克马斯基德，东至卡拉科尔，地域今分属乌兹别克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、塔吉克斯坦与哈萨克斯坦。它由明格家族统治，以浩罕为都，18至19世纪控制费尔干纳的绿洲与商路，1876年被俄国征服并废除。
politics.en: The Khanate of Kokand was an early modern state in the Fergana Valley of Central Asia. At its peak it stretched from the Ulu Tau mountains in the north to Sariqol in the south and from Aq Masjid in the west to Karakol in the east, its territory now divided among Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Kazakhstan. Ruled by the Ming dynasty of khans from Kokand, it controlled the oases and routes of Fergana in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries until Russia conquered and abolished it in 1876.

economy.zh: 经济以费尔干纳盆地的灌溉农业与手工业为基础，棉花、丝绸、果品与陶器是主要物产，汗国处在通往中国喀什与中亚各汗国的商路上，贸易税收是财政支柱。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated farming and crafts in the Fergana valley, with cotton, silk, fruit and pottery as the main products, and the khanate lay on the routes towards Kashgar and the other Central Asian khanates, trade taxation being the pillar of its finances.

culture.zh: 浩罕是费尔干纳的伊斯兰学术与文学中心，经学院与宫殿建筑留下遗产，察合台突厥语与波斯语并用，苏菲教团在社会生活中影响显著。
culture.en: Kokand was the centre of Islamic learning and literature in Fergana, its colleges and palaces leaving a heritage, Chagatai Turkic and Persian were both used, and Sufi orders were influential in social life. Its poets wrote in both Turkic and Persian.

events.zh: 关键节点包括18世纪初建国、19世纪初的扩张与对喀什的干预、19世纪中期的内部纷争，以及1876年被俄国征服。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in the early eighteenth century, the expansion and intervention in Kashgar in the early nineteenth, internal strife in the mid-nineteenth century and the Russian conquest of 1876. Its territory passed to Russian Turkestan.

value.en: Its capital was Kokand.
Russia conquered and abolished it in 1876.

en: The Mongolian People's Republic as the Mongolian communist state existing from 1924 to 1992
Its self-designation first as a people's democratic state and later as a socialist state
The Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party enshrined as the leading force of state and society
zh: 蒙古人民共和国是1924至1992年存在的蒙古共产主义国家
先自称人民民主国家，后称社会主义国家
蒙古人民革命党被确立为国家与社会的领导力量

politics.zh: 蒙古人民共和国是1924至1992年间存在的蒙古共产主义国家，先自称人民民主国家、后称社会主义国家，蒙古人民革命党被宪法确立为国家与社会的领导力量。它在苏联的影响与援助下建立计划经济与集体牧场制度，1945年后获得国际承认，1990年爆发民主抗议，1992年通过新宪法改为蒙古国。
politics.en: The Mongolian People's Republic was the Mongolian communist state that existed from 1924 to 1992, self-designated first as a people's democratic state and later as a socialist state, with the Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party enshrined as the leading force of state and society. It built a planned economy and collective herding under Soviet influence and aid, gained wide international recognition after 1945, saw democratic protests in 1990 and adopted a new constitution as Mongolia in 1992.

economy.zh: 经济以畜牧业与苏联援助下的工矿业为基础，集体牧场与国营工厂构成计划体系，乌兰巴托集中了工业与行政，1990年代转向市场经济后经历剧烈调整。
economy.en: The economy rested on herding and, with Soviet aid, on industry and mining, collective farms and state factories forming the planned system, with Ulaanbaatar concentrating industry and administration; the shift to a market economy in the 1990s brought severe adjustment.

culture.zh: 文字与教育在苏联影响下改用西里尔字母，传统蒙古文与藏传佛教受到压制，1990年后传统文字与宗教活动逐步恢复，那达慕等传统节庆延续。
culture.en: Writing and education were switched to the Cyrillic alphabet under Soviet influence and traditional Mongolian script and Tibetan Buddhism were suppressed; after 1990 the traditional script and religious practice were gradually restored, and festivals such as Naadam continued.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1924年共和国成立、1930年代的社会改造、1945年后获得国际承认、1990年民主抗议，以及1992年改国名为蒙古国。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of the republic in 1924, the social transformation of the 1930s, wide international recognition after 1945, the democratic protests of 1990 and the change of the country's name to Mongolia in 1992.

value.en: It was founded in 1924 and renamed Mongolia in 1992.

value.zh: 蒙古人民革命党被确立为领导力量。
value.en: The Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party was the leading force.

en: Minyue as an ancient kingdom in what is now Fujian province in southern China
Its contemporaneity with the Han dynasty and its annexation by the Han empire as it expanded southward
Its existence from approximately 306 BC to 110 BC
zh: 闽越是古代王国，位于今中国福建省
与汉朝同时，后随汉帝国南扩而被吞并
约存在于公元前306至前110年

politics.zh: 闽越是古代王国，位于今中国福建省一带，与汉朝同时，约存在于公元前306至110年，后随汉帝国南扩而被吞并。它由越人首领统治，都城在东冶（今福州一带），一度与南越、东瓯等政权并立；汉武帝时期因内部纷争与对抗中央而被灭，其地设郡县直接管辖。
politics.en: Minyue was an ancient kingdom in what is now Fujian province in southern China, contemporary with the Han dynasty and existing from approximately 306 BC to 110 BC, until the Han empire annexed it as it expanded southward. Ruled by Yue chiefs from its capital at Dongye, near present-day Fuzhou, it stood alongside Nan Yue and Dong Ou for a time; under Emperor Wu internal conflict and resistance to the centre led to its destruction and its territory was organised into commanderies.

economy.zh: 经济以闽江流域的稻作农业、渔捞与山林采集为基础，冶铁与造船技术见于考古发现，沿海与河口的贸易联系着东南沿海与内陆。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming in the Min river basin, fishing and forest gathering, with iron working and shipbuilding known from archaeology and trade along the coast and river mouths linking the south-east coast with the interior.

culture.zh: 闽越属百越文化圈，青铜器、印纹陶与干栏式建筑是其文化特征，与中原汉文化接触后逐步融合，地方传说与考古遗址记录了这段历史。
culture.en: Minyue belonged to the Baiyue cultural world, its bronze objects, stamped pottery and stilt houses being characteristic; contact with Han culture brought gradual assimilation, and local legend together with archaeological sites record this history. Its sites are still studied by archaeologists today.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元前306年前后立国、与南越及东瓯的关系、公元前138年的对抗，以及公元前110年被汉朝吞并设郡。
events.en: Key moments are the founding around 306 BC, relations with Nan Yue and Dong Ou, the confrontation of 138 BC and the Han annexation and establishment of commanderies in 110 BC. Its people were gradually absorbed into Han society.

value.zh: 都城在东冶，今福州一带。
value.en: Its capital was Dongye, near present-day Fuzhou.
The Han annexed it in 110 BC.

en: The Hanthawaddy Kingdom, also called Hongsawatoi or Pegu, as the major polity ruling lower Burma from 1287 to 1539 and briefly from 1550 to 1552
Its classical name Hamsavati
Its later service as an imperial centre
zh: 勃固王朝又称汉沙瓦底或勃固，是1287至1539年统治下缅甸的主要政权，1550至1552年一度复国
古典名称为汉萨瓦蒂
此后曾作为帝国的都城

politics.zh: 勃固王朝又称汉沙瓦底或勃固，是1287至1539年间统治下缅甸（今缅甸南部）的主要政权，1550至1552年一度复国，古典名称为汉萨瓦蒂。它由孟族统治者建立，以勃固为都，凭借伊洛瓦底江三角洲的稻米与海上贸易繁荣，与北方的阿瓦王朝长期对峙；16世纪中叶被东吁王朝吞并，此后一度成为东吁帝国的都城。
politics.en: The Hanthawaddy Kingdom, also called Hongsawatoi or Pegu, was the major polity ruling lower Burma from 1287 to 1539 and briefly from 1550 to 1552, its classical name being Hamsavati. Founded by Mon rulers with Pegu as its capital, it prospered on the rice of the Irrawaddy delta and maritime trade and stood for a long time against the northern kingdom of Ava; in the mid-sixteenth century the Toungoo dynasty absorbed it, after which the city served for a time as an imperial capital.

economy.zh: 经济以三角洲的稻作农业与港口贸易为基础，勃固与马塔班是重要港口，连接印度洋、马来半岛与东南亚各地的贸易，稻米、象牙与纺织品是主要商品。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming in the delta and on port trade, with Pegu and Martaban as important harbours linking the Indian Ocean, the Malay peninsula and Southeast Asia, and rice, ivory and textiles as the main goods.

culture.zh: 孟族文化是勃固王朝的核心，孟文与巴利文用于经典与行政，佛教寺院与佛塔建筑影响深远，孟族文学与法典传统在此时期成熟。
culture.en: Mon culture lay at the heart of the kingdom, Mon and Pali were used for scripture and administration, Buddhist monasteries and pagodas were influential, and Mon literature and legal tradition matured in this period. Its monks also kept the chronicles of the kingdom.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1287年建国、14至15世纪与阿瓦的长期战争、16世纪初的鼎盛，以及1539年被东吁王朝吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in 1287, the long wars with Ava in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, its height in the early sixteenth and its absorption by the Toungoo dynasty in 1539. Its port cities then declined in importance.

value.en: Its capital was Pegu.
The Toungoo dynasty absorbed it in 1539.

en: The Nguyen dynasty as the last Vietnamese dynasty, ruling unified Vietnam independently from 1802 until the start of the French protectorate in 1883
Its emperors from the House of Nguyen Phuc
Its succession to the Nguyen lords
zh: 阮朝是越南最后一个王朝，1802年起独立统治统一的越南，至1883年法国建立保护国
皇帝出自阮福家族
由阮主政权发展而来

politics.zh: 阮朝是越南最后一个王朝，由阮福家族统治，1802年阮福映统一越南称帝，定都顺化，至1883年法国建立保护国为止独立统治全国。它仿照中国制度建立六部与科举，编修史书与律例；1883年后成为法国保护国下的名义王朝，1945年保大帝退位，王朝终结。
politics.en: The Nguyen dynasty was the last Vietnamese dynasty, its emperors coming from the House of Nguyen Phuc. In 1802 Nguyen Phuc Anh unified Vietnam and took the imperial title with Hue as his capital, and the dynasty ruled the country independently until the French protectorate began in 1883. It modelled its six ministries and examinations on Chinese practice and compiled histories and law codes; after 1883 it reigned under French protection until Emperor Bao Dai abdicated in 1945.

economy.zh: 经济以红河与湄公河三角洲的稻作农业为基础，矿业、手工业与对外贸易在19世纪有所发展，赋税与徭役是国家财政与公共工程的主要来源。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming in the Red River and Mekong deltas, mining, crafts and foreign trade developed in the nineteenth century, and taxation and corvee labour were the main sources of state revenue and public works.

culture.zh: 阮朝推行儒学教育与科举，顺化的宫殿、陵墓与城墙构成今日世界遗产的核心，汉字与喃字用于文书与文学，天主教与本土信仰并存。
culture.en: The dynasty promoted Confucian education and examinations, the palaces, tombs and walls of Hue form the core of a World Heritage site, Chinese characters and the demotic nom script were used in documents and literature, and Catholicism existed alongside local beliefs.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1802年统一称帝、19世纪前期对暹罗与柬埔寨的干预、1858年起法国入侵、1883年成为保护国，以及1945年王朝终结。
events.en: Key moments are the unification and imperial title of 1802, intervention in Siam and Cambodia in the early nineteenth century, the French invasion from 1858, the protectorate of 1883 and the end of the dynasty in 1945.

value.en: Nguyen Phuc Anh unified Vietnam and took the imperial title in 1802.
Its capital was Hue.

en: Nanzhao as a dynastic kingdom flourishing in what is now south-western China and northern Southeast Asia during the eighth and ninth centuries
Its Yi-language name Mashynzy
zh: 南诏是8至9世纪兴盛于今中国西南与东南亚北部的王朝
彝语称其为 Mashynzy

politics.zh: 南诏是8至9世纪兴盛于今中国西南与东南亚北部的王朝，由乌蛮与白蛮等族群建立，都城在太和城与羊苴咩城（今大理一带）。它一度统一云南各部，与唐朝、吐蕃及东南亚政权反复结盟与交战，9世纪末在内部纷争中分裂，此后由大理国取代。
politics.en: Nanzhao was a dynastic kingdom that flourished in what is now south-western China and northern Southeast Asia during the eighth and ninth centuries, founded by peoples including the Wuman and Baiman and ruled from Taihe and later Yangjumie, near present-day Dali. It united the Yunnan tribes for a time and allied and fought by turns with Tang China, Tibet and Southeast Asian powers, breaking up in internal conflict at the end of the ninth century before the kingdom of Dali took its place.

economy.zh: 经济以云南高原的稻作、畜牧与山地采集为基础，控制通往东南亚与西藏的商路，盐、马匹、茶叶与玉石是重要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming, herding and mountain gathering on the Yunnan plateau and controlled the routes towards Southeast Asia and Tibet, with salt, horses, tea and jade as important goods of exchange. Its horses were prized by neighbouring states.

culture.zh: 南诏受佛教与唐朝文化影响，同时保留本地族群传统，崇圣寺三塔等佛教建筑是这一时期的遗产，彝语与白语文献及汉文记载共同保存其历史。
culture.en: Nanzhao was influenced by Buddhism and Tang culture while keeping local traditions, the Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple are a legacy of the period, and Yi and Bai language sources together with Chinese records preserve its history.

events.zh: 关键节点包括7世纪后期的统一、8世纪与唐朝的战争及与吐蕃的结盟、9世纪的鼎盛，以及902年后为大理国取代。
events.en: Key moments are the unification of the late seventh century, the wars with Tang and the alliance with Tibet in the eighth, its height in the ninth and its replacement by the kingdom of Dali after 902.

value.zh: 都城在太和城与羊苴咩城，今大理一带。
value.en: Its capitals were Taihe and Yangjumie, near present-day Dali.
The kingdom of Dali replaced it after 902.

en: The Sukhothai Kingdom as a post-classical Siamese kingdom in Mainland Southeast Asia centred on the ancient city of Sukhothai
Its origin as a trading town on the routes between the Mon, Tai and Xian polities and its status as a city-state by 1127
zh: 素可泰王国是中南半岛的后古典暹罗王国，中心在素可泰古城
原为孟人、泰人与暹人之间商路上的贸易城镇，1127年已成为城邦

politics.zh: 素可泰王国是中南半岛的后古典暹罗王国（曼陀罗政体），中心在素可泰古城，原为孟人、泰人与暹人之间商路上的贸易城镇，1127年已成为城邦。13世纪在兰甘亨王时期扩张为区域强国，创制泰文，与兰纳、大城等政权并立；14世纪后逐渐衰落，1438年并入大城王国。
politics.en: The Sukhothai Kingdom was a post-classical Siamese kingdom, a mandala, in Mainland Southeast Asia centred on the ancient city of Sukhothai. It began as a trading town on the routes between the Mon, Tai and Xian polities and had become a city-state by 1127, expanding into a regional power in the thirteenth century under King Ramkhamhaeng, who devised the Thai script; it stood alongside Lan Na and Ayutthaya and declined after the fourteenth century, being absorbed by Ayutthaya in 1438.

economy.zh: 经济以稻作农业与河运贸易为基础，素可泰位于永河与难河之间的商路上，参与湄南河流域与马来半岛的交换，宋加洛陶瓷是著名出口品。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming and river trade, Sukhothai lying on the routes between the Yom and Nan rivers and taking part in exchange across the Chao Phraya basin and the Malay peninsula, with Sangkhalok ceramics a famous export.

culture.zh: 素可泰被视为泰国文字、文学与佛教艺术的发祥地，兰甘亨碑铭是最早的泰文文献，行走佛造像与寺院建筑形成独特风格。
culture.en: Sukhothai is regarded as the birthplace of Thai script, literature and Buddhist art: the Ramkhamhaeng inscription is the earliest Thai text, and its walking Buddha images and temple architecture have a style of their own.

events.zh: 关键节点包括12世纪成为城邦、13世纪兰甘亨时期的扩张与泰文创制、14世纪的衰落，以及1438年并入大城王国。
events.en: Key moments are its emergence as a city-state in the twelfth century, the expansion and creation of the Thai script under Ramkhamhaeng in the thirteenth, its decline in the fourteenth and its absorption by Ayutthaya in 1438.

value.zh: 兰甘亨王时期创制泰文。
value.en: The Thai script was devised under King Ramkhamhaeng.
Ayutthaya absorbed it in 1438.

en: Wei as one of the seven major states of the Warring States period in ancient China
Its creation from the three-way partition of Jin together with Han and Zhao
Its territory between the states of Qin and Qi, including parts of modern Henan, Hebei and Shandong
zh: 魏国是中国古代战国七雄之一
与韩、赵三家分晋后建立
领土介于秦、齐之间，包括今河南、河北与山东部分地区

politics.zh: 魏国是中国古代战国七雄之一，由三家分晋后与韩、赵一同建立，领土介于秦、齐之间，包括今河南、河北与山东部分地区，都城先在大梁（今开封）。魏文侯时期任用李悝变法、吴起治军，成为战国初期国力居首的国家；此后在桂陵与马陵之战中被齐击败，又受秦蚕食，公元前225年被秦所灭。
politics.en: Wei was one of the seven major states of the Warring States period in ancient China, created from the three-way partition of Jin together with Han and Zhao, its territory lying between Qin and Qi and including parts of modern Henan, Hebei and Shandong, with its capital at Daliang, present-day Kaifeng. Under Marquis Wen it carried out Li Kui's reforms and Wu Qi's military reorganisation and became the strongest state of the early Warring States; later defeated by Qi at Guiling and Maling and eroded by Qin, it was conquered in 225 BC.

economy.zh: 魏国地处黄河中下游平原，农业发达，李悝推行尽地力之教与平籴法，重视水利与粮食储备，手工业与商业城市如大梁、安邑繁荣。
economy.en: Wei lay on the middle and lower Yellow River plain, where farming was productive; Li Kui's reforms taught the full use of the land and regulated grain prices, water works and grain stores were emphasised, and craft industries and commercial cities such as Daliang and Anyi flourished.

culture.zh: 魏国是战国学术中心之一，西门豹治邺、吴起变法与《法经》都与其相关，儒家、法家与兵家人物在此活动，为后世变法提供范本。
culture.en: Wei was one of the intellectual centres of the Warring States: the administration of Ximen Bao at Ye, Wu Qi's reforms and the Book of Law are connected with it, Confucian, Legalist and military thinkers were active there, and it provided models for later reforms.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元前403年三家分晋、魏文侯时期的强盛、公元前354至前341年与齐的战争，以及公元前225年被秦所灭。
events.en: Key moments are the partition of Jin in 403 BC, the height of power under Marquis Wen, the wars with Qi from 354 to 341 BC and the conquest by Qin in 225 BC. Its ruling house survived in a reduced form.

value.zh: 公元前403年三家分晋后建立。
value.en: It was created in the partition of Jin in 403 BC.
Qin conquered it in 225 BC.

en: Jinhan as a loose confederacy of chiefdoms in the southern Korean peninsula from around the first century BCE to the fourth century CE
Its position east of the Nakdong River valley in Gyeongsang Province
Its place among the Samhan, or Three Hans, alongside Byeonhan and Mahan
zh: 辰韩是公元前1世纪至公元4世纪朝鲜半岛南部的酋长联盟
位于庆尚道洛东江谷地以东
与弁韩、马韩并称三韩

politics.zh: 辰韩是公元前1世纪至公元4世纪存在于朝鲜半岛南部的酋长联盟，位于庆尚道洛东江谷地以东，与弁韩、马韩并称三韩。它由多个城邑国家组成，没有统一的王权，各邦首领在联盟内协调；4世纪后辰韩诸邦逐渐整合为新罗，成为朝鲜半岛三国之一的基础。
politics.en: Jinhan was a loose confederacy of chiefdoms that existed from around the first century BCE to the fourth century CE in the southern Korean peninsula, east of the Nakdong River valley in Gyeongsang Province, and one of the Samhan or Three Hans alongside Byeonhan and Mahan. Made up of several walled town-states without a single royal authority, it was coordinated among local chiefs until, after the fourth century, its polities were gradually consolidated into Silla, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea.

economy.zh: 经济以稻作农业、渔捞与冶铁为基础，洛东江流域的铁器生产与对外交换发达，通过海路与日本列岛及中国大陆往来，铁与陶器是重要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming, fishing and iron working, with iron production and external exchange well developed in the Nakdong valley, and trade by sea with the Japanese islands and the Chinese mainland, iron and pottery being important goods.

culture.zh: 辰韩社会以部族与城邑为单位，墓葬与陶器反映地方传统，与弁韩、马韩共享三韩文化圈，新罗的建国传说把辰韩诸邦与其王统联系起来。
culture.en: Jinhan society was organised by tribe and walled town, its burials and pottery reflect local tradition, it shared the Samhan cultural world with Byeonhan and Mahan, and Silla's foundation legends link its royal line to the Jinhan polities.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元前1世纪前后联盟形成、1至3世纪城邑的发展、4世纪后整合为新罗，以及此后朝鲜半岛三国格局的形成。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the confederacy around the first century BCE, the development of its town-states in the first to third centuries, its consolidation into Silla after the fourth century and the emergence of the Three Kingdoms order that followed.

value.en: It was one of the Three Hans alongside Byeonhan and Mahan.
After the fourth century it was consolidated into Silla.
